ideas.title: $19B Minnesota Fraud: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged $19B fraud in Minnesota, focusing on entities involved, potential connections to federal programs, and the role of DHS and DOJ.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the impact on Minnesota's economy and federal funding.
questions: How did the alleged fraud occur?
What are the implications for federal funding?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover significant misuse of funds and potential corruption at high levels.

ideas.title: DOJ's Inconsistent Investigations
ideas.description: Compare the DOJ's handling of the ICE agent's fatal shooting of Renee Good with similar cases, such as the George Floyd investigation.
ideas.angle: Analyze the discrepancies in investigations and potential implications for justice and equality.
questions: What are the key differences in investigations?
How do these discrepancies impact public trust?
Are there systemic issues within the DOJ?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal systemic issues within the DOJ and impact public trust in law enforcement.
